The top is gold colored, where the bottom is orange colored. The font is blocky and is in all caps.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc4462d5a6c77f8091442ab943b0adbe145fa141.png) ##
A distinct and content-rich QOL modpack, made just for you
Precautions
This modpack comes with numerous shaders, so enable whichever one you like in Video Settings -> Shader Packs. I use Sildur's Vibrant Shaders Extreme with Volumetric Lighting, but you can choose whichever one you like the most, or disable shaders entirely; I don't care. Also, be cautious when adding or updating anything by yourself, as things may break, making this modpack potentially unplayable. I will do my best to continously update this modpack to the latest possible versions that all the mods support.
About this Modpack
This modpack has 1 goal, and that's to create an enhanced Minecraft experience, tweaking as many features as possible. This modpack achieves it by adding features from a variety of mods and resource packs to give the vanilla game a fresh new coat of paint, with features such as making previously 2D objects 3D, like doors and ladders, adding a variety of shaders that give the visuals a pop of color and realism, and many other QOL features. You can see all the stuff I've added in the list below.
